name: bt11-private-targets
title: Build targets stage 11: targets, platform backends and renderer backends from outside the repository (console plugin boundary), with a sample private target
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 11 of section 5.
acceptance: A target folder outside the repository adds a target that n2build and the editor list, build and run
A platform backend and a renderer backend can be added from that folder without editing engine sources
Docs say what a console port provides and what stays private
gate: needs the user's go; depends on bt5-n2build-desktop-web
notes: Reviewer: no NDA-shaped code or names in the public repository; the boundary is stable enough to version.
